title: Adaptive Distributionally Robust Optimal Control with Bayesian Ambiguity Sets
summary: In stochastic optimal control (SOC), uncertainty may arise from incomplete knowledge of the true probability distribution of the underlying environment, which is known as Knightian or epistemic uncertainty. Distributionally robust optimal control (DROC) models are subsequently proposed to tackle this source of uncertainty. While such models are effective in some practical applications, most existing DROC models are offline and can be overly conservative when data are scarce.
